other_conditions: Student must belong to a minority community.

Student must have passed one of the specified examinations with first division/class: (i) Matriculation/Fauquania exam from the Bihar School Examination Board or Bihar Madrasa Education Board; (ii) Muslim girl student must have passed the Intermediate/Maulvi exam with first class from the Bihar School Examination Board or Bihar Madrasa Education Board; (iii) Bengali‑speaking student must have passed the Matriculation exam with first division from the Bihar School Examination Board.
benefits_summary: Minority students receive a cash incentive of ₹10,000 for Matriculation/Fauquania exams, ₹15,000 for Muslim girl students passing Intermediate/Maulvi, and ₹10,000 for Bengali‑speaking students passing Matriculation.
